source.test: loadPaperTemplates() / loadPluginTemplates() -- template list sort order

notes: `.sorted { $0.lastPathComponent.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.lastPathComponent) == .orderedAscending }` (loadPaperTemplates line 234-236, loadPluginTemplates line 54-56 -- identical logic, one function per template kind) is case-insensitive *and* locale-aware, which for this input set happens to order "1.21.4" before "1.21.10" digit-by-digit the way a person reading the list would expect. This is a genuinely different algorithm from `latestTemplate`'s raw `<` string compare above -- the display list and the "which one is latest" pick can disagree on ordering for the same directory, and that divergence is preserved rather than unified.
